description: This Java class implements a content repository that stores files and images on the file system. It provides methods for saving, deleting, and fetching files/images, with configuration-driven directory management. It uses annotations for dependency injection and conditional activation, and incorporates utilities for path sanitization and file handling.

classes.name: FileSystemContentRepository
classes.description: A Spring component that implements ContentRepository to handle storing, retrieving, and deleting files and images on the local file system, with path sanitization and directory management.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves an uploaded file to the file system in a user-specific directory based on entity type and ID, returning the file path.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves an uploaded image to the file system, supporting both InputStream and Base64EncodedImage inputs, returning the file path.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image file from the file system given its location.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file from the file system given its document path.

methods.name: fetchFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file from the file system as FileData, given document data.

methods.name: fetchImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image from the file system as FileData, given image data.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type enum indicating file system storage.

methods.name: generateFileParentDirectory
methods.description: Constructs the directory path for storing files based on entity type, ID, and tenant name.

methods.name: generateClientImageParentDirectory
methods.description: Constructs the directory path for storing client images based on resource ID and tenant name.

methods.name: makeDirectories
methods.description: Ensures that the parent directories of a given path exist, creating them if necessary.

methods.name: writeFileToFileSystem
methods.description: Writes an InputStream to the specified file location after sanitizing the path, creating directories if needed.
